title: Instructed to Bias: Instruction-Tuned Language Models Exhibit Emergent Cognitive Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model choices between a control dataset with two comparable options and a treatment dataset that includes a third asymmetrically dominated 'decoy' option to see if the decoy shifts the model's preference.

Evaluating model preferences by comparing choices between two lotteries with risk (control dataset) versus scenarios where one option provides a certain outcome (treatment dataset) with the same expected value.

Assessing the model's ability to evaluate logical syllogisms by comparing its validity judgments on consistent arguments (e.g., valid and believable) against inconsistent arguments (e.g., valid but unbelievable) using real-world objects.
